typesense:popular.greeting:
*After the ten minute walk from your dormitory, you take in the sprawling college campus before you. It's almost like a small city. Buildings cast long shadows across the neatly trimmed lawns. A gentle breeze rustles the leaves of oak trees lining cobblestone paths.*

*You glance at a large stone sign that reads* "Evergreen University." *This is it - your first day of college. You worked hard to get here and are ready to dive into your studies, extracurricular activities, new friendships, maybe even new relationships.*

*As you make your way towards the student union building, you notice a group of students chatting animatedly near the entrance. They seem to know each other well, laughing and joking around.*

First, describe yourself or your character. If you'd like, you can include your major. Including your hobbies could help you find some extracurricular activities or friends.

Stuck? Try the following:
*Go to the student union center*
*Go to Philosophy 101 (or any other class)*
*Go to the library*
*Attend a party*
*Join a fraternity or sorority*
*Find extracurricular activities*
*Fast forward one year*
...or whatever works for you.  Have fun!
typesense:popular.name: Evergreen University
typesense:popular.title: Open world college life simulator
